summary: Write headings in the simple words people would search for, but keep them under about 50 to 60 characters since search engines truncate and long headings wrap on phones.
questions: How long should documentation headings be?
How do I pick a heading people will search for?

answer_card.title: Clear, searchable headings
answer_card.answer_md: Think about what a reader (especially a newcomer) would type into search, and make the heading answer that. Keep it short: search engines truncate past **50 to 60 characters**, and long headings wrap on phones.
